Foundry lost $2,474M in the quarter.

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 9% to $12.7B and gross margin widened to 41.0% from 34.2% a year ago, so the net loss attributable to Intel narrowed to $381M from $2,758M. On a non-GAAP basis — excluding share-based pay, restructuring and investment gains — Intel earned $759M, or $0.18 per share, above its guidance.
takeaways.title: The loss shrank by 86%

takeaways.text: Intel Foundry lost $2,474M on $4,369M of segment revenue, and only $27M of that revenue came from outside customers — down 77% YoY — the rest was wafers sold to Intel's own product groups. The product groups earned $3,311M combined: Client Computing $2,645M, Data Center and AI $482M and Network and Edge $184M.
takeaways.title: Foundry lost more than the product groups earned

takeaways.text: Operations used $1,223M of cash in the quarter while Intel spent $5,970M on factories and equipment, leaving adjusted free cash flow of $(6,178)M. Intel paid $529M in dividends and guided Q2 to $12.5–13.5B of revenue with GAAP EPS of $(0.05).
takeaways.title: Cash flow went backwards

verdict: Intel still lost money in the first quarter — $381 million attributable to Intel on $12.7 billion of revenue — but the loss shrank 86% from a year ago as PC chip sales jumped 31%.
